Manage durable guest terminal sessions.

```text
pomme sessions SUBCOMMAND
```

## pomme sessions list

List terminal sessions.

```text
pomme sessions list [NAME] [--json] [--format FORMAT] [--debug] [--progress PROGRESS]
```

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `NAME` | VM name. Uses `POMME_VM_NAME` when omitted. |

This command also accepts the [common flags](/reference/cli/#common-flags).

## pomme sessions inspect

Inspect a terminal session.

```text
pomme sessions inspect [NAME] --session ID [--json] [--format FORMAT] [--debug] [--progress PROGRESS]
```

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `NAME` | VM name. Uses `POMME_VM_NAME` when omitted. |

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--session ID` | Terminal session ID, as printed by `pomme sessions list`. |

This command also accepts the [common flags](/reference/cli/#common-flags).

## pomme sessions attach

Attach to a terminal session.

```text
pomme sessions attach [NAME] --session ID [--takeover] [--from-start] [--from-offset FROM_OFFSET] [--json] [--format FORMAT] [--debug] [--progress PROGRESS]
```

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `NAME` | VM name. Uses `POMME_VM_NAME` when omitted. |

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--session ID` | Terminal session ID, as printed by `pomme sessions list`. |
| `--takeover` | Replace the current attachment. |
| `--from-start` | Replay the transcript from byte offset zero. |
| `--from-offset FROM_OFFSET` | Replay from this exact transcript byte offset. |

This command also accepts the [common flags](/reference/cli/#common-flags).

## pomme sessions logs

Read terminal session transcript bytes.

```text
pomme sessions logs [NAME] --session ID [--from-offset FROM_OFFSET] [--follow] [--json] [--format FORMAT] [--debug] [--progress PROGRESS]
```

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `NAME` | VM name. Uses `POMME_VM_NAME` when omitted. |

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--session ID` | Terminal session ID, as printed by `pomme sessions list`. |
| `--from-offset FROM_OFFSET` | Starting transcript byte offset. Default: `0`. |
| `--follow` | Continue until the session exits or is lost. |

This command also accepts the [common flags](/reference/cli/#common-flags).

## pomme sessions terminate

Terminate a terminal session.

```text
pomme sessions terminate [NAME] --session ID [--force] [--json] [--format FORMAT] [--debug] [--progress PROGRESS]
```

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `NAME` | VM name. Uses `POMME_VM_NAME` when omitted. |

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--session ID` | Terminal session ID, as printed by `pomme sessions list`. |
| `--force` | Send SIGKILL instead of SIGHUP. |

This command also accepts the [common flags](/reference/cli/#common-flags).

## pomme sessions delete

Delete an exited or lost terminal session.

```text
pomme sessions delete [NAME] --session ID [--json] [--format FORMAT] [--debug] [--progress PROGRESS]
```

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `NAME` | VM name. Uses `POMME_VM_NAME` when omitted. |

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--session ID` | Terminal session ID, as printed by `pomme sessions list`. |

This command also accepts the [common flags](/reference/cli/#common-flags).
